title: Band-9 Samples: At what times of day do you like to listen to music? [Why?]
content:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 10 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 2 question:

“At what times of day do you like to listen to music? [Why?]”

Sample 1

I particularly enjoy listening to music when I’m occupied with tasks that don’t require much concentration. For instance, when I’m engaged in cooking or tidying up my living space. The rhythmic beats of music make these rather monotonous chores seem more enjoyable and less dull.

Sample 2

I often listen to music in the evening, shortly after getting home from work. It’s a wonderful way to unwind and detach from the day’s stress. The harmonious tunes help me transition from a hectic work environment to a more relaxed home atmosphere, acting as a buffer between two vastly different parts of my day.

Sample 3

I prefer listening to music when I’m exercising, which usually happens in the early evening. The adrenaline rush from a high-tempo song perfectly complements the physical exertion, making the workout seem less strenuous and more enjoyable. It’s a surefire way to keep myself motivated during my fitness routine.

Sample 4

I know it might sound a bit unusual, but I love listening to music while taking a shower. The acoustics in the bathroom are surprisingly good, and the act of singing along to my favorite tunes in this private space is liberating. It’s an excellent way to start or end the day on a high note.

Sample 5

Personally, I love tuning into music right after my midday meal. It’s a ritual for me to take a quick siesta following lunch, and I find that music serves as a wonderful companion. It’s fascinating how it has the potential to not only relax me but also recharge my energy levels and prepare me for the forthcoming tasks of the day.

Sample 6

For me, the most ideal time to enjoy music is when I’m engrossed in my work or studies. I’ve noticed that certain genres, especially instrumental or classical, seem to enhance my focus and concentration. The melodious tunes act as a sort of creative fuel, helping me maintain a steady pace of productivity. I believe it’s because the harmonious sounds offer a form of sonic distraction that allows my thoughts to flow more freely.

Sample 7

I find myself tuning into music most often in the morning, particularly on my bus commute to work or school. It’s a great way to make use of idle time during the journey. The rhythmic beats of music help me transition from the tranquility of dawn to the bustling day ahead. Occasionally, if I’m particularly tired, I’ve even found that a soothing melody can lull me into a short and restful nap before reaching my destination.

Sample 8

I usually find myself reaching for my earphones during my daily commute. The city’s hustle and bustle can be a bit overwhelming at times, and music serves as a perfect escape. Whether it’s a crowded train or a traffic jam, with music, it becomes a little more bearable.

Sample 9

I find immense pleasure in listening to melodies during the nocturnal hours, particularly when I’m engrossed in a captivating novel. There’s something about the tranquility of the night that makes the music more resonant and the words of the book more impactful.

Sample 10

Actually, I have a penchant for listening to soothing tunes when night falls, just before I drift off to sleep. It’s an effective way to unwind, and it creates a tranquil atmosphere that makes falling asleep quite effortless.
